plugins.name: hippo
plugins.description: hippo — your project's hippocampus: task registry, outcome ledger, and background clerks that give agents perception and memory — evidence over enforcement.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Personal fork of openai/codex-plugin-cc with OS-level sandbox enforcement removed and replaced with prompt-level self-enforcement, for environments where bubblewrap cannot run (cloud containers, GPU hosts, kernels without unprivileged user/network namespace permission).

plugins.name: ccbroker
plugins.description: Claude account switching, quota status and rotation policy via ccbroker: /ccb-status, /ccb-use, /ccb-auto and /ccb-policy slash commands plus a SessionStart hook that runs 'ccb pull' (requires the ccb binary on PATH).

plugins.name: ezsub
plugins.description: Lightweight scoped string substitution: replace A with B in lines, line ranges, markdown sections, files, or directories
